 * - Columns in HiddenColumns() are never sent back.

class [[table_nice_name]]Base extends BasePage
{
    public static ?ChangeLogHistory $History = null;

    public static ?[[c_name]] $Item = null;

    /** Column that ties a row to the user who owns it ('' if the table has none). */
    protected static string $OwnerColumn = '[[owner_column]]';

    /**

     * @return string[]

        return [[fields]];
    }

    /**

     * @return string[]

        return [[hidden_columns]];

    /**
     * Foreign keys into tables with an owner column: column => 'Class::column'. A request may only
     * point these at rows the signed-in user can see. References to tables without a user_id
     * (e.g. clients kept in a users table) aren't covered; check those in CheckReferences().
     * @return array<string, string>
     */
    protected static function References(): array
    {
        return [[references]];
    }

    /**
     * Refuse request values that point at rows the signed-in user can't see.
     * Override (and call parent::CheckReferences()) to add checks of your own.
     *
     * @param array $req the request, limited to Fields()
     * @return string|null an error message, or null if it's fine
     */
    protected static function CheckReferences(array $req): ?string
    {
        foreach (static::References() as $col => $target) {
            if (!array_key_exists($col, $req) || $req[$col] === null || $req[$col] === '') {
                continue;
            }
            [$class, $column] = explode('::', $target);
            $row = $class::Get([$column => $req[$col]]);
            if (!$row || !$row->VisibleTo()) {
                return 'Invalid ' . $col;
            }
        }
        return null;
    }

    /**
     * @return string[]
     */
    protected static function PrimaryKey(): array
    {
        return [[primary_columns]];
    }

    /**
     * @return void
     */
    private static function CheckUser(): void
    {
        if (!CurrentUser::ID()) {
            HTTP::ExitJSON(['error' => 'Invalid Request'], HTTP::HTTP_STATUS_UNAUTHORIZED);
        }
    }

    /**
     * @return bool
     */
    private static function HasPrimaryKey(): bool
    {
        return !([[missing_params]]);
    }

    /**
     * @return void
     */
    private static function LoadItem(): void
    {
        if (!self::HasPrimaryKey()) {
            HTTP::ExitJSON(['error' => 'Missing ID'], HTTP::HTTP_STATUS_BAD_REQUEST);
        }

        self::$Item = [[c_name]]::Get([[[get_params]]]);

        // a record you can't see is reported the same as one that doesn't exist
        if (!self::$Item || !self::$Item->VisibleTo()) {
            HTTP::ExitJSON(['error' => 'Invalid ID'], HTTP::HTTP_STATUS_NOT_FOUND);
        }
    }

    /**
     * The request, limited to Fields().
     * @return array
     */
    protected static function RequestFields(): array
    {
        $req = array_intersect_key(Request::toArray(), array_flip(static::Fields()));
        foreach (static::PrimaryKey() as $col) {
            unset($req[$col]);
        }
        if (static::$OwnerColumn !== '') {
            unset($req[static::$OwnerColumn]);
        }
        return $req;
    }

    /**
     * Apply the allowed request fields, check the result is still visible, and save.
     * @return void
     */
    private static function ApplyAndSave(bool $is_new): void
    {
        $req = self::RequestFields();

        $error = static::CheckReferences($req);
        if ($error) {
            HTTP::ExitJSON(['error' => $error], HTTP::HTTP_STATUS_BAD_REQUEST);
        }

        // models treat a request without its primary key as a new record
        if (!$is_new) {
            foreach (static::PrimaryKey() as $col) {
                $req[$col] = self::$Item->$col;
            }
        }

        $res = self::$Item->FromRequest($req, false, true); // keep columns the request didn't send
        if ($res->error) {
            HTTP::ExitJSON(['error' => $res->error], HTTP::HTTP_STATUS_BAD_REQUEST);
        }

        if ($is_new && static::$OwnerColumn !== '') {
            $owner = static::$OwnerColumn;
            self::$Item->$owner = CurrentUser::ID();
        }

        if (!self::$Item->VisibleTo()) {
            HTTP::ExitJSON(['error' => 'No Permission'], HTTP::HTTP_STATUS_BAD_REQUEST);
        }

        $res = self::$Item->Save();
        if ($res->error) {
            HTTP::ExitJSON(['error' => $res->error], HTTP::HTTP_STATUS_BAD_REQUEST);
        }
    }

    /**
     * @param [[c_name]] $item
     * @return array
     */
    protected static function Output([[c_name]] $item): array
    {
        $res = $item->ToJSONArray();
        foreach (static::HiddenColumns() as $col) {
            unset($res[$col]);
        }
        return $res;
    }

    /**
     * QuickDRY.Read
     * @return void
     */
    public static function Get(): void
    {
        Request::FromSerialized(Request::Get('serialized'));

        self::CheckUser();
        self::LoadItem();

        $res = static::Output(self::$Item);
        $res['can_delete'] = self::$Item->CanDelete();
        HTTP::ExitJSON(['data' => $res]);
    }

    /**
     * QuickDRY.Update
     * @return void
     */
    public static function Post(): void
    {
        Request::FromSerialized(Request::Get('serialized'));

        self::CheckUser();
        self::LoadItem();
        self::ApplyAndSave(false);

        HTTP::ExitJSON(['data' => static::Output(self::$Item)]);
    }

    /**
     * QuickDRY.Create (with a primary key, an update of a record you can see)
     * @return void
     */
    public static function Put(): void
    {
        Request::FromSerialized(Request::Get('serialized'));

        self::CheckUser();

        $is_new = !self::HasPrimaryKey();
        if ($is_new) {
            self::$Item = new [[c_name]]();
        } else {
            self::LoadItem();
        }

        self::ApplyAndSave($is_new);

        HTTP::ExitJSON(['data' => static::Output(self::$Item)]);
    }

    /**
     * @param string $success_message
     * @return void
     */
    public static function Delete(string $success_message = 'Item Removed'): void
    {
        Request::FromSerialized(Request::Get('serialized'));

        self::CheckUser();
        self::LoadItem();

        if (!self::$Item->CanDelete()) {
            HTTP::ExitJSON(['error' => 'No Permission'], HTTP::HTTP_STATUS_BAD_REQUEST);
        }

        $res = self::$Item->Remove();
        if ($res->error) {
            HTTP::ExitJSON(['error' => $res->error], HTTP::HTTP_STATUS_BAD_REQUEST);
        }

        HTTP::ExitJSON(['success' => $success_message]);
    }

    /**
     * @return void
     */
    public static function Find(): void
    {
        Request::FromSerialized(Request::Get('serialized'));

        self::CheckUser();

        HTTP::ExitJSON(['error' => 'Find Not Implemented'], HTTP::HTTP_STATUS_BAD_REQUEST);
    }

    /**
     * @return void
     */
    public static function History(): void
    {
        Request::FromSerialized(Request::Get('serialized'));

        self::CheckUser();
        self::LoadItem();

        self::$History = self::$Item->history;

        if (!self::$History || !sizeof(self::$History->changes)) {
            HTTP::ExitJSON(['error' => 'No History Available'], HTTP::HTTP_STATUS_NOT_FOUND);
        }

        $hidden = array_flip(static::HiddenColumns());
        $report = [];

        $m = sizeof(self::$History->changes);
        foreach (self::$History->changes as $i => $cl) {
            foreach ($cl->changes_list as $column => $change) {
                if ([[c_name]]::IgnoreColumn($column) || isset($hidden[$column])) {
                    continue;
                }
                $r = [
                    'Rev' => $m - $i,
                    'Column' => $column,
                    'Value' => self::$Item->ValueToNiceValue($column),
                    'Was' => self::$Item->ValueToNiceValue($column, $change->old, true),
                    'Now' => self::$Item->ValueToNiceValue($column, $change->new, true),
                    'When' => Dates::StandardDateTime($cl->created_at),
                    'By' => $cl->GetUser(),

                ];
                $report [] = $r;
            }
        }
        HTTP::ExitJSON(['history' => $report]);
    }
